run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the most frequent element in the first n elements of an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and print the number of successful results
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which sorts an array and counts consecutive duplicates to find the most frequent element
review_f_gold: review f_gold for its sorting-based approach to finding the most frequent element in an array
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array by sorting a copy instead
